prompt: Investors ask for the SaaS quick ratio of each quarter of 2025 (event_date from 1 January to 31 December 2025): the MRR gained from new, expansion and reactivation events divided by the MRR lost to contraction and churn events, the loss taken as a positive amount. Each event's event_type names its movement (new, expansion, contraction, churn or reactivation); a reactivation is an account coming back after it churned, never new MRR. Leave out the opening events: they carry the MRR subscriptions already had when the data starts on 1 January 2024. Convert every amount to euros at one fixed rate, that of 31 December 2025: multiply by fx_rates.eur_per_unit for the subscription's currency on 2025-12-31. Round the ratio to 2 decimals with ROUND; it is missing for a quarter that lost no MRR. Return two columns, in this order: quarter_start (the first day of the quarter) and quick_ratio. Return one row for each quarter of 2025. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, add up the gains and the losses of each quarter with two conditional sums, then divide.
Losses are negative in mrr_delta_local, so flip their sign before dividing the gains by them.
why_this_works: Gains over losses, both at one fixed rate, show how many euros of MRR each quarter won for every euro it lost.
